topics.topic: Whether start_instance may add or correct the content-length response header
questions: Must the response header fields remain unchanged, or may the CONTENT_LENGTH_HEADER field be added when absent and corrected when present with a value other than the body's byte length?
Must the response header fields be written unchanged, or may the named content-length header be added when absent?
Must the response header fields remain unchanged, or may start_instance add the content-length header when it is absent?

quotes: the HttpResponse either answers MUST be written back as one response with its status, header fields and body unchanged
among its header fields, the one the imported CONTENT_LENGTH_HEADER constant names giving the body's length in bytes, added when its own header fields hold none
judgement.why: Adding the required content-length header when it is absent changes the response's header fields, so that obligation cannot be obeyed together with the obligation to write those fields unchanged.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
